tasks.label: Run current file
tasks.command: if [[ '${fileExtname}' == '.sql' ]]; then .venv/bin/python -c "import duckdb,sys; con=duckdb.connect('taxi.duckdb'); [print(con.sql(q)) for q in open(sys.argv[1]).read().split(';') if q.strip() and not all(l.strip().startswith('--') or not l.strip() for l in q.splitlines())]" '${file}'; else .venv/bin/python '${file}'; fi
